text_block_list.text:
After some time out together, Meisho
Doto and I
return to the academy.

T-Trainer! Would you mind if, after this,
we...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Bzzt, bzzt!

It's a message from Tazuna. Looks like
there's an
important task that needs a
lot of hands on deck.
She's asked me to
help out.
I s-suppose you have work to do now...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
Wasn't there something you were going to tell
me?

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it was nothing! Good luck with
y-your
work!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I reluctantly part ways with Meisho
Doto,
switching gears to my new task.

After everything is put in order, I step
outside to
find the sky completely dark.
I guess I should
head home.

Hey. You're Doto's trainer, aren't you?
Got any
idea where she is?
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I thought she was back at her dorm...

text_block_list.text:
Nope. Around this time, she's normally
making a
racket getting ready for the
next day.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Tch, I swear, if that accident on legs runs
into
trouble this late at night... Where
the hell could
she be?
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
We've got to find her as soon as
possible! I go
looking for Мэйсё Дото
with Air Shakur.

Shakur has a guess as to Doto's
whereabouts, so I
trust her gut and
follow along to...

If you haven't noticed, she's been
sneaking out
here a lot lately. And
tracking mud into our room
when she
sneaks back...
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text: Oooh... Ohhh...
Hm? You hear that?
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Ahh... I reminisce on your gentle...
waarmth!
Eep! T-Trainer! Shakur?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm n-n-not imagining things, right? Is
that really...
you?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
You sleep-deprived or something? Of
course it's
us!
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text: Uugh... Waaaahh! I was s-so scaaared!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Hic... I'm so s-sorry...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I decided to practice my singing here, but then... Hic! I c-couldn't find my way back in the dark... I was singing to help me calm down.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I wasn't there for you.

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, please don't apologize... Your
work is far
more important than me!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to become... more
independent. That
way, you'll be able to
focus on your work, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I don't want to be a nuisance to you...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
You should focus on screwing up less
first. Surely
you could've avoided what
led you into this mess.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
We escort Мэйсё Дото back to the
dorm.
Thankfully, she's not injured. I
suppose all is calm
for now.

I'm so ashamed to have caused all th-this
trouble!
I'm really sorry... it's all my fault!
I won't do
something like this ever again!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Damn right, you won't! I'm not going
looking for
you a second time.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
I u-understand... I'm so s-sorry! I won't
practice
singing anymore!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh... But, what if something like this
happens
again?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Figure it out on your own! I already said
I'm not
playing search patrol anymore.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Doto?

text_block_list.text:
I, um... Well, you see! I think I like
singing a lot
more now...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
If it's not a b-bother to anyone... I would
like to
keep singing.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
...Then you'd better come up with a
more
reasonable way to practice.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! Um, well... I won't sing in the
forest
anymore!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
I'd like to hear the song whenever you're ready
to perform.
Let me join you for practice!

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! Um, well... I won't sing in the
forest
anymore!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
I'd like to hear the song whenever you're ready
to perform.
Let me join you for practice!

text_block_list.text:
Hyah?! You're willing to listen to m-my
singing?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Wh-whaaat?! I'll practice a whole, whole
lot, then.
I pwo-promishe!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't! I already rely on you for
training...
this would add on so much
work for you!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I want to be with you as you improve.

text_block_list.text:
Well... If you're really sure you want to
come...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I decide to accompany Мэйсё Дото for
singing
practice the following day.

Ever since then, I occasionally overhear
Doto
singing when I pass by the dorm.
